title: review-backend-code input
description: Input contract for the review-backend-code Review stage. Consumes the design plus the entire output of an upstream Generate stage plus the file contents the workflow fetched. Validated by the workflow engine before invocation.

design_document.description: The same approved design document the upstream Generate stage consumed. Used at step 2 to extract the truth against which claims are checked.

target_package.description: Same Go package path the Generate stage targeted.

implement_stage_output.description: Verbatim output payload of implement-backend-feature for this feature. Structure validated separately against that skill's schemas/output.json.

code_under_review.description: Production files emitted by Generate. Each entry includes the file content so the reviewer can cite file:line.

tests_under_review.description: Companion tests emitted by Generate. Empty array is invalid — banking-grade never reviews production without companion tests.

idempotency_key.description: UUID v4 carried from the workflow. Same key + same other inputs MUST produce the same verdict bytes.

convention_overrides.description: Optional. Same shape as the implement stage's overrides — passed to the reviewer so a divergence from defaults is not mis-flagged.

severity_floor.description: Findings below this severity are dropped from the output. Default P3 (emit everything). Set P2 or P1 only for noisy reviews.
